publication.title: Schema-Backed Visual Queries over Europeana and Other Linked Data Resources

source_reading.scope: All substantive sections: motivation, schema extraction steps and failure fallbacks, visual query environment, SHACL generation and limitations. References inspected for companion links.

adjudication.basis: The implemented ViziQuer environment uses an extracted data-driven schema to support visual construction, property-path completion and execution of cultural-heritage instance queries. Schema extraction and SHACL generation are new contributions; the exploration object is actual Europeana RDF data, rather than schema editing alone. No recruited user study or timed performance benchmark is reported.

studies.cohort_note: Cross-report participant overlap is not established.
studies.design: Schema extraction and worked Europeana query demonstrations
studies.results: Two visual versions of a query are translated and executed; endpoint schema supports SHACL generation.
limitations: Readability advantages are claims without a recruited user comparison. No extraction accuracy, end-user task-time or latency denominator reported.

descriptions.interaction: Build linked class/property query diagrams, complete class/property/path names, translate diagrams into SPARQL and execute them over Europeana.
descriptions.guidance: Actual class/property connections, cardinalities, frequencies and significant domain/range coverage guide applicable class/property choices. Untyped targets remain selectable where the computed target-class set is not a complete range.
descriptions.backend: Actual RDF endpoint instances; extracted schema can also be serialized as SHACL descriptions.
